items.name: Segment tree
items.description: Segment tree for range queries or updates.

items.name: Segment-tree monoid
items.description: Design a segment-tree aggregate as an associative monoid with custom merge semantics.

items.name: Compressed monoid
items.description: Store a compact representative of a monoid value while preserving enough information for merges or queries.

items.name: Fenwick tree
items.description: Fenwick tree, also known as a binary indexed tree, for prefix aggregates, point updates, and prefix lower_bound.

items.name: Stack
items.description: Stack used to manage nested, delayed, or last-in-first-out state.

items.name: Cartesian tree
items.description: Build or use a Cartesian tree, often with a monotonic stack, to decompose ranges by minimum or maximum elements.

items.name: Dynamic array
items.description: Maintain an appendable sequence with direct indexed access.

items.name: Disjoint set union
items.description: Maintain connected components with union-find.

items.name: Rollback DSU
items.description: Maintain disjoint-set union states with undo operations for offline divide-and-conquer or DFS traversal.

items.name: Small-to-large merging
items.description: Merge smaller sets or containers into larger ones to bound total movement.

items.name: Set container
items.description: Maintain explicit sets of elements with insertion, deletion, or membership checks.

items.name: Frequency table
items.description: Maintain counts of values or keys under insertions, deletions, and frequency-based queries.

items.name: Square-root decomposition
items.description: Split data or queries into square-root sized blocks or heavy/light classes to balance rebuild, scan, and precomputation costs.

items.name: Mo's algorithm
items.description: Order offline range queries by block so adjacent queries can be answered by incremental endpoint moves.

items.name: Block list
items.description: Maintain a sequence as blocks that can be split, trimmed, removed, inserted, or searched with amortized costs.

items.name: Mergeable blocks
items.description: Maintain blocks that can be merged into equivalent larger blocks while preserving query behavior.

items.name: Monoid composition
items.description: Compose associative transformations or summaries so multiple operations can be applied as one aggregate.

items.name: Binary counter blocks
items.description: Maintain power-of-two sized blocks and repeatedly merge equal-size blocks like binary carrying.

items.name: Trie
items.description: Store sequences or bit patterns in a prefix tree for traversal, lookup, or counting.

items.name: Binary trie
items.description: Store integer bit patterns in a binary trie for XOR queries, pair counting, or bitwise order statistics.

items.name: Priority queue
items.description: Maintain elements or states ordered by a maximum or minimum priority key.

items.name: Order-statistic tree
items.description: Maintain dynamic ordered elements with rank, kth-element, or prefix lower_bound queries.

items.name: Functional graph
items.description: Model one-outgoing-edge transitions with cycles, trees into cycles, or binary lifting tables.

items.name: Persistent segment tree
items.description: Maintain versioned segment tree roots under updates.

items.name: Path copying
items.description: Create persistent updates by cloning nodes along an update path.

items.name: Range sum query
items.description: Query sums over an interval.

items.name: Lazy segment tree
items.description: Segment tree with lazy propagation for range updates.
